evidence.decision: Chooses system versus justified custom picker and binds the displayed swatch and edits to the actual selection identity.
evidence.artifact: Requires a target/picker/commit specification or implemented binding, including preview and drop behavior.
evidence.transformation: Diagram example repairs stale swatches and wrong-object edits by updating selection and explicitly routing picker/drop changes to the current target.
evidence.verification: Checks selection changes, mixed colors, drag/drop, repeated picks and provided cancellation; fails swatch/applied-value disagreement.
evidence.applicability: Preserves Mac activation/drag behavior, tvOS/watch nonapplicability and unspecified visionOS details; withholds display-color fidelity claims.
evidence.handoffs: Loads color for meaning and drag-and-drop for transfer semantics only when those problems are present.
evidence.distinctiveness: Target identity and picker/swatch synchronization provide specific color-well decisions rather than a general color-style checklist.
